
read the README.md for project setup and contribution guidelines.

The point of this project is not only to complete the challenges but also to explain the thought process and reasoning behind each solution. 

when writing solutions, make sure to include comments that explain all non trivial language features;
* Cross joins
* Lateral Join
* Window Functions
* Recursive CTEs

To keep things easy to follow, keep seperate parts of your query in named CTEs with descriptive names. Comment each CTE to explain its purpose and logic.
